SpecialDesc0_100.en: Your foster father is never idle... Why is it so quiet today?
SpecialDesc0_100.cn: 平日你义父总闲不下一刻，怎么今日如此安静？
SpecialDesc0_100.ru: Твой приемный отец никогда не сидит сложа руки... Почему сегодня так тихо?

SpecialDesc0_101.en: A treacherous undercurrent... Without a boat, crossing seems impossible...
SpecialDesc0_101.cn: 好凶险的暗河！若是没有船只恐怕难以渡过……
SpecialDesc0_101.ru: Коварное подводное течение... Без лодки переправа кажется невозможной...

SpecialDesc0_103.en: The monkey den is near. Shall we take a look?
SpecialDesc0_103.cn: 附近便是顽猴巢穴，不妨前往一探……
SpecialDesc0_103.ru: Обезьянье логово совсем рядом. Может, нам стоит взглянуть?

SpecialDesc0_104.en: The fire is raging... Someone's crying for help!
SpecialDesc0_104.cn: 好猛烈的火势……村中似乎有人求救！
SpecialDesc0_104.ru: Огонь бушует вовсю... Кто-то зовет на помощь!

SpecialDesc0_106.en: Once we cross this river, we may find your foster father...
SpecialDesc0_106.cn: 待我们渡过暗河，或许便能寻到你的义父……
SpecialDesc0_106.ru: Как только мы пересечем эту реку, мы, возможно, найдем твоего приемного отца...

SpecialDesc0_107.en: I wonder what lies beyond this deep valley... No matter, as long as you are by my side...
SpecialDesc0_107.cn: 不知深谷之外的天地，又是何种模样？也罢，只要有你在我身边……
SpecialDesc0_107.ru: Интересно, что лежит за пределами этой глубокой долины?.. Не важно, пока ты рядом со мной...

SpecialDesc1_32.en: That sound... could it be the "Chickens" known for its love of crickets?
SpecialDesc1_32.cn: 这叫声……难道是那喜食促织的‘元鸡’？
SpecialDesc1_32.ru: Этот звук... может быть, это "Цыплята", известные своей любовью к Сверчкам?

SpecialDesc1_45.en: There's a Cricket Tournament nearby. This is my specialty!
SpecialDesc1_45.cn: 附近竟有促织大会，这斗促织可是我的‘拿手绝活’！
SpecialDesc1_45.ru: Неподалеку проходит турнир по Сверчку. Это моя специальность!

SpecialDesc1_169.en: Hush... hear that? A great one hides nearby!
SpecialDesc1_169.cn: 嘘……你听这虫鸣，附近肯定藏着个大家伙！
SpecialDesc1_169.ru: Тише... слышишь это? Великий прячется неподалеку!

SpecialDesc2_33.en: There's a tea gathering nearby? Such a small venue might be enough to entertain country folks...
SpecialDesc2_33.cn: 附近是在举办茶会？这样小的排场，招待山野村夫倒也足够了……
SpecialDesc2_33.ru: Где-нибудь поблизости есть место для чаепития? Такого небольшого помещения могло бы быть достаточно, чтобы развлечь деревенских жителей...

SpecialDesc2_34.en: There's a feast nearby? Such a small venue might be enough to entertain country folks...
SpecialDesc2_34.cn: 附近是在举办酒宴？这样小的排场，招待山野村夫倒也足够了……
SpecialDesc2_34.ru: Где-нибудь поблизости намечается пир? Такого небольшого помещения могло бы быть достаточно, чтобы развлечь деревенских жителей...

SpecialDesc2_38.en: There's a debate nearby. To compete would surely tarnish my noble lineage...
SpecialDesc2_38.cn: 附近似在举办较艺，参与此等比试，恐怕辱没了我的身份，想我祖上……
SpecialDesc2_38.ru: Неподалеку проходит Диспут. Соревнование, несомненно, запятнало бы мое благородное происхождение...

SpecialDesc2_106.en: Are we truly leaving? The Martial World is vast and lonesome—why not roam it together?
SpecialDesc2_106.cn: 便要离开此处了么？江湖寂寥，你我正可作伴遨游……
SpecialDesc2_106.ru: Мы действительно уходим? Мир боевых искусств огромен и одинок — почему бы не побродить по нему вместе?

SpecialDesc2_157.en: In the golden days of my forebears, treasures beyond counting passed through our hands—these merchants hold no marvel for me...
SpecialDesc2_157.cn: 想我祖上繁盛之时，什么珍宝不曾见过？这些行商走贩，可入不得我眼……

SpecialDesc3_28.en: My sister and I grew up here... now when I think back, those memories are but fleeting...
SpecialDesc3_28.cn: 我与姐姐自幼生长于此……如今忆起往事，皆是过眼云烟罢了……
SpecialDesc3_28.ru: Мы с сестрой выросли здесь... теперь, когда я оглядываюсь назад, эти воспоминания всего лишь мимолетны...

SpecialDesc3_37.en: There's a martial arts competition nearby. I'd rather not draw my enemies' attention...
SpecialDesc3_37.cn: 附近正在举办比武，我自不想参与，若叫仇家发现了我……
SpecialDesc3_37.ru: Неподалеку проходят соревнования по Боевым искусствам. Я бы предпочел не привлекать внимания своих врагов...

SpecialDesc3_106.en: Are we truly leaving? The Martial World is treacherous, but I shall see to your safety...
SpecialDesc3_106.cn: 便要离开此处了么？江湖险恶，我自会护你周全……
SpecialDesc3_106.ru: Мы действительно уходим? Мир боевых искусств коварен, но я позабочусь о вашей безопасности...

SpecialDesc3_112.en: This place is overrun with wicked beggars. The world is dangerous, but don't worry—I will keep you safe.
SpecialDesc3_112.cn: 此处恶丐盘踞，世道这样的险恶，也罢……我自会护你周全……

SpecialDesc3_113.en: This place is plagued by thieves. The world is dangerous, but don't worry—I will keep you safe.
SpecialDesc3_113.cn: 此地贼匪盘踞，世道这样的险恶，也罢……我自会护你周全……
SpecialDesc3_113.ru: Это место кишит ворами. Мир опасен, но не волнуйся — я обеспечу твою безопасность.

SpecialDesc3_114.en: This place is overrun with bandits... The world is ruthless, but don't worry—I will keep you safe.
SpecialDesc3_114.cn: 此地悍匪盘踞，世道这样的险恶，也罢……我自会护你周全……
SpecialDesc3_114.ru: Это место наводнено бандитами... Мир безжалостен, но не волнуйся — я обеспечу твою безопасность.

SpecialDesc3_115.en: This place harbors sect traitors... The world is cruel, but don't worry—I will keep you safe.
SpecialDesc3_115.cn: 此地门派叛徒盘踞，世道这样的险恶，也罢……我自会护你周全……
SpecialDesc3_115.ru: Это место укрывает предателей Секты... Мир жесток, но не волнуйся — я буду оберегать тебя.

SpecialDesc3_116.en: Evildoers dwell here... The world is harsh, but don't worry—I will keep you safe.
SpecialDesc3_116.cn: 此地恶徒盘踞，世道这样的险恶，也罢……我自会护你周全……
SpecialDesc3_116.ru: Здесь обитают злодеи... Мир суров, но не волнуйся — я буду оберегать тебя.

SpecialDesc3_117.en: Bewitching women linger here... The world is treacherous, but don't worry—I will keep you safe.
SpecialDesc3_117.cn: 此地妖女盘踞，世道这样的险恶，也罢……我自会护你周全……
SpecialDesc3_117.ru: Здесь задерживаются очаровательные женщины... Мир коварен, но не волнуйся — я буду оберегать тебя.

SpecialDesc3_118.en: Restless spirits haunt these grounds... The world is cruel, but don't worry—I will keep you safe.
SpecialDesc3_118.cn: 此地鬼物盘踞，世道这样的险恶，也罢……我自会护你周全……
SpecialDesc3_118.ru: Беспокойные Духи обитают на этих землях... Мир жесток, но не волнуйся — я буду оберегать тебя.

SpecialDesc3_119.en: Wandering eccentrics gather here... The world is dangerous, but don't worry—I will keep you safe.
SpecialDesc3_119.cn: 此地左道异士盘踞，世道这样的险恶，也罢……我自会护你周全……
SpecialDesc3_119.ru: Здесь собираются странствующие чудаки... Мир опасен, но не волнуйся — я обеспечу твою безопасность.

SpecialDesc3_120.en: Outland cultists lurk here... The world is dangerous, but don't worry—I will keep you safe.
SpecialDesc3_120.cn: 此地异疆邪徒盘踞，世道这样的险恶，也罢……我自会护你周全……
SpecialDesc3_120.ru: Здесь скрываются инопланетные культисты... Мир опасен, но не волнуйся — я обеспечу твою безопасность.

SpecialDesc3_121.en: Madmen roam these lands... The world is ruthless, but don't worry—I will keep you safe.
SpecialDesc3_121.cn: 此地丧心人盘踞，世道这样的险恶，也罢……我自会护你周全……
SpecialDesc3_121.ru: Безумцы бродят по этим землям... Мир безжалостен, но не волнуйся — я обеспечу твою безопасность.

SpecialDesc3_122.en: Demonic Cult congregants gather here... The world is perilous, but don't worry—I will keep you safe.
SpecialDesc3_122.cn: 此地魔教教众盘踞，世道这样的险恶，也罢……我自会护你周全……
SpecialDesc3_122.ru: Здесь собираются прихожане демонического культа... Мир полон опасностей, но не волнуйся — я буду оберегать тебя.

SpecialDesc3_123.en: Reclusive masters dwell here. The world is treacherous, but don't worry—I will keep you safe.
SpecialDesc3_123.cn: 此地隐世高手盘踞，世道这样的险恶，也罢……我自会护你周全……
SpecialDesc3_123.ru: Здесь обитают мастера-затворники. Мир коварен, но не волнуйся — я буду оберегать тебя.

SpecialDesc3_124.en: Xiake walk these lands, said to save the weak and aid the suffering, much like a Taoist...
SpecialDesc3_124.cn: 此地似有义士踪迹，听闻他们救死扶危，所为倒是与道长一般……
SpecialDesc3_124.ru: Сяке ходит по этим землям, говорят, чтобы спасать слабых и помогать страждущим, совсем как даос...

SpecialDesc3_125.en: Xiake walk these lands, said to save the weak and aid the suffering, much like a Taoist...
SpecialDesc3_125.cn: 此地似有义士踪迹，听闻他们救死扶危，所为倒是与道长一般……
SpecialDesc3_125.ru: Сяке ходит по этим землям, говорят, чтобы спасать слабых и помогать страждущим, совсем как даос...

SpecialDesc3_126.ru: Сяке ходит по этим землям, говорят, чтобы спасать слабых и помогать страждущим, совсем как даос...

SpecialDesc4_36.en: There's a marketplace nearby. Far livelier than our village—the cat would surely be delighted at this...
SpecialDesc4_36.cn: 这边正在举办集市，比村中热闹许多，要是小猫……瞧见定会喜欢……

SpecialDesc4_106.en: Are we truly leaving? The world is full of burdens—I shall shoulder them for you...
SpecialDesc4_106.cn: 便要离开此处了么？世事繁杂，我自会为你排忧解难……
SpecialDesc4_106.ru: Мы действительно уходим? Мир полон бремени — я взвалю его на свои плечи ради тебя...

SpecialDesc4_127.en: Black Bear's trail nearby. I shall guide you, but brute strength alone won't do—music may be the key...
SpecialDesc4_127.cn: 这边似有黑熊踪迹，我带你去好了，要捕捉黑熊光有力气可不行，还得会些音律……

SpecialDesc4_128.en: The Monkey's Head Mushrooms grow here. I shall lead the way, but a keen mind in Weiqi is needed, not just strength...
SpecialDesc4_128.cn: 这边似有猴头菇生长，我带你去好了，要寻找猴头菇光有力气可不行，还得会些棋艺……

SpecialDesc4_129.en: Blue peacocks are nearby. I shall lead you, but to catch it, one must possess the painting skill rather than mere strength...
SpecialDesc4_129.cn: 这边似有蓝孔雀踪迹，我带你去好了，要捕捉蓝孔雀光有力气可不行，还得会绘画……

SpecialDesc4_130.en: The Kaluga grows here. I shall guide you, but literature, not mere strength, may be the key...
SpecialDesc4_130.cn: 这边似有鲟鳇鱼踪迹，我带你去好了，要捕捉鲟鳇鱼光有力气可不行，还得会诗书……
SpecialDesc4_130.ru: Здесь растет калуга. Я буду направлять вас, но ключом может быть литература, а не просто Сила...

SpecialDesc4_131.en: The Purpletwist Bamboo grows here. I shall guide you, but gold and silver may be needed, not just strength...
SpecialDesc4_131.cn: 这边似有九曲紫竹生长，我带你去好了，要找九曲紫竹光有力气可不行，还得带上些金银材料……

SpecialDesc4_132.en: Here grows the Dark Sandalwood. I shall guide you, but iron materials may be needed, not just strength...
SpecialDesc4_132.cn: 这边似有乌金紫檀踪迹，我带你去好了，要找乌金紫檀光有力气可不行，还得带上些坚铁材料……

SpecialDesc4_133.en: I sense Cicadae Gold nearby. Follow me, but strength alone won't suffice—you'll need fine jade as well...
SpecialDesc4_133.cn: 这边似有蝉壳精金踪迹，我带你去好了，要找蝉壳精金光有力气可不行，还得带上些玉材……

SpecialDesc4_134.en: Aerosiderite may be near. I shall lead the way. Strength alone won't do though—you'll need gemstone as well.
SpecialDesc4_134.cn: 这边似有玄铁踪迹，我带你去好了，要寻玄铁光有力气可不行，还得带上些石材……

SpecialDesc4_135.en: The Kunlun Oily Jade should lie ahead. I shall guide you, but know that strength alone won't do—you'll need fabrics.
SpecialDesc4_135.cn: 这边似有昆仑活玉踪迹，我带你去好了，要捕获昆仑活玉光有力气可不行，还得带上些织物材料……

SpecialDesc4_136.en: Deus Gemstone may lie ahead. Follow me, but strength alone won't suffice—you'll need fur fabrics...
SpecialDesc4_136.cn: 这边似有神照石踪迹，我带你去好了，要寻到神照石光有力气可不行，还得带上些毛皮材料……
SpecialDesc4_136.ru: Драгоценный камень Deus может лежать впереди. Следуйте за мной, но одной Силы будет недостаточно — вам понадобятся меховые ткани...

SpecialDesc4_137.en: Cicada Goldwing may lie ahead. Follow me, but strength alone won't suffice—you'll need wood.
SpecialDesc4_137.cn: 这边似有金蝉踪迹，我带你去好了，寻到金蝉光有力气可不行，还得带上些木材……
SpecialDesc4_137.ru: Цикада златокрылая может быть впереди. Следуйте за мной, но одной Силы будет недостаточно — вам понадобятся дрова.

SpecialDesc4_138.en: Panthea may lie ahead. Follow me, but strength alone won't suffice—you'll need bamboo and rattan.
SpecialDesc4_138.cn: 这边似有天蚕踪迹，我带你去好了，要寻到天蚕光有力气可不行，还得带上些竹藤材料……
SpecialDesc4_138.ru: Пантея может лежать впереди. Следуйте за мной, но одной Силы будет недостаточно — вам понадобятся бамбук и ротанг.

SpecialDesc4_139.en: Spirit herbs and stones may lie nearby. Follow me, but mere strength won't suffice—you'll need medical art...
SpecialDesc4_139.cn: 这边似有仙草灵石出世，我带你去好了，要找到它们光有力气可不行，还得会些医术……

SpecialDesc4_140.en: Rare beasts and insects, as well as spirit plants and herbs may lie nearby. Follow me, but strength alone won't suffice—you'll need medical art...
SpecialDesc4_140.cn: 这边似有珍兽异虫、仙草灵植出世，我带你去好了，要找到它们光有力气可不行，还得会些医术……

SpecialDesc4_141.en: Lingzhi and rare plants may lie nearby. Follow me, but mere strength won't suffice—you'll need medical art...
SpecialDesc4_141.cn: 这边似有灵芝仙草出世，我带你去好了，要找到它们光有力气可不行，还得会些医术……

SpecialDesc4_142.en: Spirit herbs and stones may lie nearby. Follow me, but mere strength won't suffice—you'll need medical art...
SpecialDesc4_142.cn: 这边似有仙草灵石出世，我带你去好了，要找到它们光有力气可不行，还得会些医术……

SpecialDesc4_143.en: Spiritual creatures and items may lie nearby. Follow me, but mere strength won't suffice—you'll need medical art...
SpecialDesc4_143.cn: 这边似有异兽神石、奇葩灵物出世，我带你去好了，要找到它们光有力气可不行，还得会些医术……

SpecialDesc4_144.en: The Poison Hemlock may lie nearby. Follow me, but mere strength won't suffice—you'll need Acritoxin Resistance...
SpecialDesc4_144.cn: 这边似有断肠草生长，我带你去好了，要找到断肠草光有力气可不行，还得不惧烈毒……

SpecialDesc4_145.en: The Vilified Blossom may lie nearby. Follow me, but mere strength won't suffice—you'll need Umbritoxin Resistance...
SpecialDesc4_145.cn: 这边似有邪窍花生长，我带你去好了，要找到邪窍花光有力气可不行，还得不惧郁毒……

SpecialDesc4_146.en: The Sanguis Toad may lie nearby. Follow me, but mere strength won't suffice—you'll need Pyrotoxin Resistance...
SpecialDesc4_146.cn: 这边似有血蟾踪迹，我带你去好了，要找到血蟾光有力气可不行，还得不惧赤毒……

SpecialDesc4_147.en: The Millennia Ice Silkworm may lie nearby. Follow me, but mere strength won't suffice—you'll need Cryotoxin Resistance...
SpecialDesc4_147.cn: 这边似有冰蚕踪迹，我带你去好了，要找到冰蚕光有力气可不行，还得不惧寒毒……

SpecialDesc4_148.en: The Millennia Cyan Spider may lie nearby. Follow me, but mere strength won't suffice—you'll need Toxicology...
SpecialDesc4_148.cn: 这边似有千年青蛛踪迹，我带你去好了，要找到千年青蛛光有力气可不行，还得会些毒术……

SpecialDesc4_149.en: The Shapeshift Mandala may lie nearby. Follow me, but mere strength won't suffice—you'll need Toxicology...
SpecialDesc4_149.cn: 这边似有人面曼陀罗生长，我带你去好了，要采得人面曼陀罗光有力气可不行，还得会些毒术……

SpecialDesc4_155.en: I've seen such beasts before while gathering wood—best not provoke them...
SpecialDesc4_155.cn: 我从前进山砍柴时，便见识过这些猛兽的厉害，可不要随便招惹它们……
SpecialDesc4_155.ru: Я уже видел таких зверей раньше, когда собирал дрова — лучше их не провоцировать...

FamilyDesc_0.en: Now that we've arrived at Taiwu Village, let's take a moment to rest and recover...
FamilyDesc_0.cn: 既已抵达太吾村，不妨在村中休养片时，以解旅途乏累……
FamilyDesc_0.ru: Теперь, когда мы прибыли в Деревню Тайу, давайте немного отдохнем и придем в себя...

FamilyDesc_33.en: There's a tea gathering nearby. While tea may bond people, it can also sap one's strength...
FamilyDesc_33.cn: 附近正在举办茶会，与人饮茶虽可增进情谊，但亦会伤身……
FamilyDesc_33.ru: Неподалеку есть место для чаепития. В то время как чай может сблизить людей, он также может подорвать их Силы...

FamilyDesc_34.en: There's a feast nearby. While liquor may bond people, it can also sap one's strength...
FamilyDesc_34.cn: 附近正在举办酒宴，与人饮酒虽可增进情谊，但亦会伤身……
FamilyDesc_34.ru: Неподалеку устраивается пир. В то время как Вино может сблизить людей, оно также может подорвать Силы человека...

FamilyDesc_35.en: The wedding has begun. I rejoice for you, yet... a hint of melancholy lingers...
FamilyDesc_35.cn: 婚礼已然开始，我自然为你欢喜，可不知为何……又心生惆怅……
FamilyDesc_35.ru: Свадьба началась. И все же я радуюсь за тебя... сохраняется оттенок меланхолии...

FamilyDesc_61.en: The Capital is hosting a grand betrothal contest—a refined beauty is seeking a worthy partner...
FamilyDesc_61.cn: 京城正在举办招亲，听闻招亲的佳人气度雍容……
FamilyDesc_61.ru: В столице проходит грандиозный конкурс на обручение — утонченная красавица ищет достойного партнера...

FamilyDesc_62.en: Dali is hosting a grand betrothal contest—a bold and spirited lady awaits...
FamilyDesc_62.cn: 大理正在举办招亲，听闻招亲的佳人豪爽奔放……
FamilyDesc_62.ru: Дали устраивает грандиозный конкурс на помолвку — смелая и Духом одухотворенная леди ждет вас...

FamilyDesc_63.en: Taiyuan is hosting a grand betrothal contest—a warrior maiden is seeking an equal...
FamilyDesc_63.cn: 太原正在举办招亲，听闻招亲的佳人巾帼不让须眉……
FamilyDesc_63.ru: В Тайюане проходит грандиозный конкурс на обручение — девушка-воин ищет себе равного...

FamilyDesc_64.en: Shouchun is hosting a grand betrothal contest—an untamed huntress is seeking a worthy match...
FamilyDesc_64.cn: 寿春正在举办招亲，听闻招亲的佳人英姿飒飒……
FamilyDesc_64.ru: Шоучун устраивает грандиозный конкурс на помолвку — неукротимая охотница ищет достойного жениха...

FamilyDesc_65.en: Guangzhou is hosting a grand betrothal contest—an elegant and ethereal lady awaits...
FamilyDesc_65.cn: 广州正在举办招亲，听闻招亲的佳人清雅绝尘……
FamilyDesc_65.ru: В Гуанчжоу проходит грандиозный конкурс на обручение — вас ждет элегантная и неземная леди...

FamilyDesc_66.en: Chengdu is hosting a grand betrothal contest—an unrestrained spirit is seeking a worthy partner...
FamilyDesc_66.cn: 成都正在举办招亲，听闻招亲的佳人豪迈不羁……
FamilyDesc_66.ru: В Чэнду проходит грандиозный конкурс на обручение — необузданный Дух ищет достойного партнера...

FamilyDesc_67.en: Yangzhou is hosting a grand betrothal contest—beauties gather in dazzling splendor...
FamilyDesc_67.cn: 扬州正在举办招亲，听闻佳人如云，叫人眼花缭乱……
FamilyDesc_67.ru: В Янчжоу проходит грандиозный конкурс на обручение — красавицы собираются в ослепительном великолепии...

FamilyDesc_68.ru: В Ханчжоу проходит грандиозный конкурс на помолвку — сентиментальная леди ждет вас...

FamilyDesc_69.ru: В Гуйчжоу проходит грандиозный конкурс на обручение — талантливая и миловидная леди ждет вас...

FamilyDesc_76.ru: Вы проводите конкурс на помолвку в столице — возможно, чтобы найти мужа со статусом и властью?

FamilyDesc_87.cn: 你于秦州举办招亲，可是想寻一个有胆有谋的夫婿么……

FamilyDesc_89.cn: 你于辽阳举办招亲，可是想寻一个意气轩昂的夫婿么……
FamilyDesc_89.ru: Вы проводите конкурс на обручение в Ляояне — возможно, чтобы найти мужа со смелым Духом?

FamilyDesc_90.en: You're holding a Betrothal Contest in Qingzhou—to seek a husband destined for you, perhaps?
FamilyDesc_90.cn: 你于青州举办招亲，可是想寻那个命中注定之人……
FamilyDesc_90.ru: Вы проводите конкурс на обручение в Цинчжоу — возможно, чтобы найти мужа, предназначенного вам судьбой?

FamilyDesc_91.en: Legends speak of this mound's bone-chilling cold and untold perils. Stay sharp...
FamilyDesc_91.cn: 传闻此冢奇寒无比，凶险万分，还需留心……
FamilyDesc_91.ru: Легенды рассказывают о леденящем до костей холоде этого кургана и неисчислимых опасностях. Оставайся начеку...

FamilyDesc_92.en: It is said this mound might unsettle the mind and is fraught with peril. Tread carefully...
FamilyDesc_92.cn: 传闻此冢乱人心神，凶险万分，还需留心……
FamilyDesc_92.ru: Говорят, что этот холм может выбить из колеи разум и таит в себе опасность. Действуйте осторожно...

FamilyDesc_93.en: It is said this mound is impenetrable and perilous. Stay wary...
FamilyDesc_93.cn: 传闻此冢坚不可摧，凶险万分，还需留心……
FamilyDesc_93.ru: Говорят, что этот курган непроходим и опасен. Будь осторожен...

FamilyDesc_94.en: Rumor has it that wicked forces lurk within this mound—tread carefully, for danger abounds...
FamilyDesc_94.cn: 传闻此冢凶物伏藏，凶险万分，还需留心……
FamilyDesc_94.ru: Ходят слухи, что в этом кургане скрываются злые силы — действуйте осторожно, ибо опасность таится в изобилии...

FamilyDesc_95.en: Cloaked in mystery and fraught with peril. Best be on guard...
FamilyDesc_95.cn: 传闻此冢诡秘难测，凶险万分，还需留心……
FamilyDesc_95.ru: Окутанный тайной и таящий в себе опасность. Лучше всего быть начеку...

FamilyDesc_96.en: Hidden powers lie dormant here, yet the dangers are real. Stay cautious...
FamilyDesc_96.cn: 传闻此冢威能潜藏，凶险万分，还需留心……
FamilyDesc_96.ru: Скрытые силы дремлют здесь, но опасности реальны. Оставайся осторожным...

FamilyDesc_97.en: Poison taints this land, danger lurks unseen. Stay sharp...
FamilyDesc_97.cn: 传闻此冢剧毒横流，凶险万分，还需留心……
FamilyDesc_97.ru: Яд отравляет эту землю, невидимая опасность подстерегает нас. Оставайся начеку...

FamilyDesc_98.en: A mound steeped in fierce aura, danger lurks at every turn. Be on guard...
FamilyDesc_98.cn: 传闻此冢杀气腾腾，凶险万分，还需留心……
FamilyDesc_98.ru: Холм, окутанный свирепой аурой, опасность подстерегает на каждом шагу. Будь начеку...

FamilyDesc_99.en: Ever-changing and treacherous, best proceed with care...
FamilyDesc_99.cn: 传闻此冢变幻莫测，凶险万分，还需留心……
FamilyDesc_99.ru: Постоянно меняющийся и коварный, лучше всего действовать осторожно...

FamilyDesc_111.en: If there is a way, I shall take your place and brave that hazardous spot...
FamilyDesc_111.cn: 若有法门，我自愿以身代你，去那虎穴龙潭一探……
FamilyDesc_111.ru: Если есть способ, я займу твое место и отважусь пройти это опасное место...

FamilyDesc_155.en: Wild beasts roam these lands—stay alert, lest you come to harm...
FamilyDesc_155.cn: 山野之中多有凶禽猛兽，你可要多加留心，别伤了自己……
FamilyDesc_155.ru: Дикие звери бродят по этим землям — будьте начеку, чтобы вам не причинили вреда...

FamilyDesc_158.en: Look—is the one ahead one of your kin?
FamilyDesc_158.cn: 你瞧，前方那人，好似也是你的亲戚？
FamilyDesc_158.ru: Посмотри — тот, что впереди, один из твоих сородичей?

FamilyDesc_159.en: Your friend is here as well—shall we go greet them?
FamilyDesc_159.cn: 我忽见你那友人也在此地，可要前去打个照面？
FamilyDesc_159.ru: Твой друг тоже здесь — может, пойдем поприветствуем их?

FamilyDesc_160.en: I just saw someone you hold enmity with—shall we avoid them?
FamilyDesc_160.cn: 我方才瞧见一与你素有嫌隙之人，可要避让一二？
FamilyDesc_160.ru: Я только что видел кое—кого, с кем ты враждуешь - может, нам стоит избегать их?

FamilyDesc_167.en: A grave lies ahead... could it belong to one we once knew...?
FamilyDesc_167.cn: 我见附近似有坟墓，也不知可是你我的故人……
FamilyDesc_167.ru: Впереди могила... Может ли она принадлежать тому, кого мы когда-то знали...?

FamilyDesc_171.en: A familiar presence lingers... have you lost something here?
FamilyDesc_171.cn: 似是有股熟悉的气息……你可曾于此地落下什么？
FamilyDesc_171.ru: Знакомое присутствие сохраняется... вы что-то здесь потеряли?

FamilyDesc_187.en: This place reeks of death... tread carefully...
FamilyDesc_187.cn: 此地甚是可怖，你可千万小心，不要置自己于险境……
FamilyDesc_187.ru: Это место пропахло смертью... Действуйте осторожно...

FamilyDesc_188.en: Flames rage wild here... mind your step, lest you be consumed...
FamilyDesc_188.cn: 此地火势异常凶猛，你当千万小心，莫要引火烧身......
FamilyDesc_188.ru: Пламя здесь бушует неистово... следите за своими шагами, чтобы вас не поглотило...

FriendDesc_94.en: Rumor has it that wicked forces lurk within this mound—tread carefully, for danger abounds...

FriendDesc_94.ru: Ходят слухи, что в этом кургане скрываются злые силы — действуйте осторожно, ибо опасность таится в изобилии...

FriendDesc_95.en: Cloaked in mystery and fraught with peril. Best be on guard...

FriendDesc_95.ru: Окутанный тайной и таящий в себе опасность. Лучше всего быть начеку...

FriendDesc_97.en: Poison taints this land, danger lurks unseen. Stay sharp...

FriendDesc_97.ru: Яд отравляет эту землю, невидимая опасность подстерегает нас. Оставайся начеку...

FriendDesc_98.en: A mound steeped in fierce aura, danger lurks at every turn. Be on guard...

FriendDesc_98.ru: Холм, окутанный свирепой аурой, опасность подстерегает на каждом шагу. Будь начеку...

FriendDesc_99.en: Ever-changing and treacherous, best proceed with care...

FriendDesc_99.ru: Постоянно меняющийся и коварный, лучше всего действовать осторожно...

FriendDesc_111.en: Friends may be countless, yet true confidants are few... Take care on your journey to the realm of the Land of Blackstones!
FriendDesc_111.cn: 相识满天下，知心能几人……玄石之境一行，万万珍重！

FriendDesc_155.en: Wild beasts roam these lands—stay alert, lest you come to harm...
FriendDesc_155.cn: 山野之中多有凶禽猛兽，你可要多加留心，别伤了自己……
FriendDesc_155.ru: Дикие звери бродят по этим землям — будьте начеку, чтобы вам не причинили вреда...

FriendDesc_158.en: I believe I see your kin up ahead.
FriendDesc_158.cn: 瞧那前方，我好似见到了你家中亲眷……
FriendDesc_158.ru: Мне кажется, я вижу впереди твоих сородичей.

FriendDesc_159.en: I have seen a familiar face—one of you friends...
FriendDesc_159.cn: 我忽见一眼熟之人，仿佛与你亦是好友……
FriendDesc_159.ru: Я увидел знакомое лицо — одного из ваших друзей...

FriendDesc_160.en: I believe an enemy of yours lies nearby—stay wary...
FriendDesc_160.cn: 我好似瞧见与你不睦之人，心中不免戒备几分……
FriendDesc_160.ru: Я верю, что твой враг находится поблизости — будь осторожен...

FriendDesc_167.en: A lone mound stands before us... who rests here, forgotten by time...?
FriendDesc_167.cn: 我见近有荒丘青冢，不知何人长眠此处……
FriendDesc_167.ru: Перед нами возвышается одинокий курган... кто покоится здесь, забытый временем...?

FriendDesc_171.en: A familiar presence lingers... have you lost something here?
FriendDesc_171.cn: 似是有股熟悉的气息……你可曾于此地落下什么？
FriendDesc_171.ru: Знакомое присутствие сохраняется... вы что-то здесь потеряли?

FriendDesc_187.en: This place reeks of death... tread carefully...
FriendDesc_187.cn: 此地甚是可怖，你可千万小心，不要置自己于险境……
FriendDesc_187.ru: Это место пропахло смертью... Действуйте осторожно...

FriendDesc_188.en: Flames rage wild here... mind your step, lest you be consumed...
FriendDesc_188.cn: 此地火势异常凶猛，你当千万小心，莫要引火烧身......
FriendDesc_188.ru: Пламя здесь бушует неистово... следите за своими шагами, чтобы вас не поглотило...

Cricket_91_0.en: This mound appears simple and plain on the surface, yet its master's mind is shackled by mortal sentiments. In the end, they are nothing more than a mediocre soul...
Cricket_91_0.cn: 此冢表面质朴，剑主心念却困于凡情，终究只是庸愚之辈……

Cricket_91_1.en: The master of this Sword Mound still harbors a flicker of kindness, yet has been seized by evil intent. We have no choice but to put them down—how very lamentable...
Cricket_91_1.cn: 这剑冢之主善念仍存，却遭邪念所控，我等只得将其除去，何其可哀……

Cricket_91_2.en: The spiritual will within this mound is turbulent and its evil intent bone-chilling. Its master must have long endured bitter suffering—even my Enchanting Tones may not be enough to move their heart...
Cricket_91_2.cn: 冢中灵意纷扰，邪念阴寒，冢主定然久历悲苦，我之魔音未必能动其心……

Cricket_91_3.en: The spiritual Qi of this mound is bone-chillingly cold and truly perilous. Should you require aid, remember to call upon me...
Cricket_91_3.cn: 此冢灵气冰寒冻骨，实在危险，若需相助，切记呼唤于我……

Cricket_91_4.en: Within this Dark Frost lies a singular, piercing cold. Yet I have nurtured my sword for years for this very purpose—to sever all evils. I shall not shrink back now...
Cricket_91_4.cn: 这大玄凝中奇寒无比，但我养剑多年，便是为斩除群邪，自不会退缩……

Cricket_91_5.en: The thoughts within this mound are cold and profound, and the evil within is no common phantom. Should we set foot through this gate, allow me to lead the way...
Cricket_91_5.cn: 冢中念头极为冷邃，其内邪祟绝非凡俗，若入此门，我当先锋而行……

Cricket_91_6.en: The spiritual will within this mound is an entanglement of good and evil, with its master forced to succumb to Demonic Qi. The injustice of it weighs on my chest and sets my blood boiling...
Cricket_91_6.cn: 冢中灵念善恶交织，冢主迫服于魔气，压得我心头窝囊，火冒三丈……

Cricket_91_7.en: The air around this mound is bone-chillingly cold and pale grass sprouts in sorrow. The perils within are unpredictable—should you intend to enter, you must take me with you...
Cricket_91_7.cn: 冢周阴寒彻地，白草凄生，内中凶险难料，你若入内务必携我同行……

Cricket_91_8.en: The cold within this mound seeps into the bones, and demons plague the Zen mind. The master of this sword is trapped in ignorance, and I cannot say when they might find liberation...
Cricket_91_8.cn: 此冢寒气侵骨，魔乱禅心，其中剑主困于无明，不知何时可得解脱……

Cricket_91_9.en: I possess boundless courage—why should I fear these fierce demons? Whatever myriad perils lie within the mound, leave it to me to fend them off...
Cricket_91_9.cn: 我有一身胆气，何惧这些凶魔，冢中纵有万般凶险，尽管交由我来挡下……

Cricket_91_10.en: Evil Qi pierces to the bone here, and frigid spirits blot out the sun. Now that the place is overrun by demons, we who hold righteousness in our hearts must stand forever opposed to this wicked force...
Cricket_91_10.cn: 此地邪气侵骨，寒灵蔽日，如今更遭妖魔侵占，我等心有正气，当与此邪势不两立……

Cricket_91_11.en: This mound harbors a lifetime of misery, into which Demonic Qi has crept. Shrouded as it is in cold mist, I shall settle this tragic karma today...
Cricket_91_11.cn: 此冢藏尽一生凄苦，更遭魔气趁虚而入，被寒雾所笼，今日我便了却这桩悲业……

Cricket_91_12.en: A chilling evil fills the air of this mound. Demons hide within, yet they dare not show themselves for battle—truly laughable...
Cricket_91_12.cn: 此冢寒邪弥天，妖魔藏匿其中，却不敢现身一战，徒惹人笑……

Cricket_91_13.en: The corrupt Qi within the mound runs rampant, ceaselessly freezing and eroding mortal souls. I possess the three-colored Royal Blood, and thus have nothing to fear...
Cricket_91_13.cn: 冢中朽气霍乱，不断冻蚀人魂，我有三色王血，自不畏之……

Cricket_91_14.en: The mound is heavy with cold Qi and steeped in stifling melancholy. Yet for this sorrow to twist into evil Qi is truly tiresome...
Cricket_91_14.cn: 冢中寒气沉沉，苦闷一腔愁绪，只是这愁怨化了邪气，也着实无趣……

Cricket_91_15.en: This mound is congealed with Yin cold and filth, and the sword master has utterly lost their mind. It would be best to put an end to this swiftly...
Cricket_91_15.cn: 此冢阴寒凝秽，剑主已心性尽丧，不若趁早了结……

Cricket_91_16.en: The sorrow of this Dark Frost refuses to dissipate. In the end, they drifted along with the mundane tide and lost their noble character...
Cricket_91_16.cn: 这大玄凝悲苦不散，终是从俗浮沉，失却清贵风骨……

Cricket_91_17.en: The master of the sword harbored an obsession, and devolved into a Yin evil before the barriers of their heart could be cleared. Lamentable... truly lamentable...
Cricket_91_17.cn: 剑主生有痴念，心障未除便化成了阴邪，可悲，可悲……

Cricket_91_18.en: Within this Dark Frost, righteous and evil thoughts are tightly entwined. Their plight is truly pitiable, yet they have ultimately succumbed to their inner demons and strayed from the righteous path...
Cricket_91_18.cn: 这大玄凝中正邪念头交错，情实可悯，却终已化魔，失了正道……

Cricket_91_19.en: The master within the mound dwells alongside demons, their profound sorrow twisted into foul evil. Better that I cleanse this place with karmic fire and burn it all to ash...
Cricket_91_19.cn: 冢中剑主与魔同栖，满腔悲苦化作秽邪，不若以我业火涤荡，皆尽烧净……

Cricket_91_20.en: Dark Frost was corrupted by Demonic Qi and turned into a frozen mound, imprisoning solitary souls. We all share a bitter fate—they have merely strayed from the path...
Cricket_91_20.cn: 大玄凝受魔气所侵，化作寒冢，囚着孤魂，我等命途皆苦，他只是走岔了路……

Better to use my karmic fire to cleanse and burn it all away...,Dark Frost, invaded by Demonic Qi, has turned into a cold Mound, imprisoning a lonely soul. Our destinies are all bitter; he merely took the wrong path...}
Cricket_91_21.cn: {这剑冢之中寒气幽异，我被其牵动思绪，莫名漾起怆然之情……,此冢表面质朴，剑主心念却困于凡情，终究只是庸愚之辈……,这剑冢之主善念仍存，却遭邪念所控，我等只得将其除去，何其可哀……,冢中灵意纷扰，邪念阴寒，冢主定然久历悲苦，我之魔音未必能动其心……,此冢灵气冰寒冻骨，实在危险，若需相助，切记呼唤于我……,这大玄凝中奇寒无比，但我养剑多年，便是为斩除群邪，自不会退缩……,冢中念头极为冷邃，其内邪祟绝非凡俗，若入此门，我当先锋而行……,冢中灵念善恶交织，冢主迫服于魔气，压得我心头窝囊，火冒三丈……,冢周阴寒彻地，白草凄生，内中凶险难料，你若入内务必携我同行……,此冢寒气侵骨，魔乱禅心，其中剑主困于无明，不知何时可得解脱……,我有一身胆气，何惧这些凶魔，冢中纵有万般凶险，尽管交由我来挡下……,此地邪气侵骨，寒灵蔽日，如今更遭妖魔侵占，我等心有正气，当与此邪势不两立……,此冢藏尽一生凄苦，更遭魔气趁虚而入，被寒雾所笼，今日我便了却这桩悲业……,此冢寒邪弥天，妖魔藏匿其中，却不敢现身一战，徒惹人笑……,冢中朽气霍乱，不断冻蚀人魂，我有三色王血，自不畏之……,冢中寒气沉沉，苦闷一腔愁绪，只是这愁怨化了邪气，也着实无趣……,此冢阴寒凝秽，剑主已心性尽丧，不若趁早了结……,这大玄凝悲苦不散，终是从俗浮沉，失却清贵风骨……,剑主生有痴念，心障未除便化成了阴邪，可悲，可悲……,这大玄凝中正邪念头交错，情实可悯，却终已化魔，失了正道……,冢中剑主与魔同栖，满腔悲苦化作秽邪，不若以我业火涤荡，皆尽烧净……,大玄凝受魔气所侵，化作寒冢，囚着孤魂，我等命途皆苦，他只是走岔了路……}

Cricket_92_0.en: The Sword Master's Mind is stubborn and foolish, to the point that Obsession - Thought turns into fire. Do not approach this place, lest you be tainted by misfortune...
Cricket_92_0.cn: 冢中剑主心性顽愚，以至痴念化火，你莫要靠近此处，免得沾染晦气……

Cricket_92_1.en: Around the Mound, the fire of love burns Divine; I cannot stand these entanglements of love—truly troublesome...
Cricket_92_1.cn: 冢周情火焚神，我最见不得这些情爱纠葛，实在麻烦……

Cricket_92_2.en: This Mound's spiritual intentions have accumulated, like unexpressed hidden feelings; love and hate are deeply buried within, almost making me want to compose a melody for it...
Cricket_92_2.cn: 此冢灵意郁积，宛若幽怀未诉，爱恨深埋其中，几欲令我为之谱曲……

Cricket_92_3.en: This Mound's spiritual Qi flows like living fire, ever-changing and varied; the Sword Master must be extremely adept at the art of maneuvering—I truly wish to compete with him...
Cricket_92_3.cn: 此冢灵气流如活火，千变万状，剑主定然极擅腾挪之法，真想与其一较高下……

Cricket_92_4.en: Within this Ignideus Blaze, love-thoughts turn to fire, burning Divine and destroying souls. My sword cannot sever its threads of love, yet I do not fear this evil...
Cricket_92_4.cn: 这焚神炼中情念化火，焚神灭魄，我剑难断其情丝，却也不惧此邪……

Cricket_92_5.en: Within the Mound, fervent thoughts are all about dying for love; that Sword Master must be one who throws caution to the wind and fears not death...
Cricket_92_5.cn: 冢中炽念，尽为殉情之意，那剑主必是奋不顾死之辈……

Cricket_92_6.en: This Sword Master's love-thoughts are fervent and sincere; he even fights against the Demonic Qi within the Mound. If not for his excessive attachment, he would be to my liking...
Cricket_92_6.cn: 这剑主情念炽诚，竟与冢中魔气相斗，若非执着过甚，倒是合我脾性……

Cricket_92_7.en: Around the Mound, fire spirits are scorched and chaotic; the Sword Master must have gone mad. If you wish to face this man directly, be sure to guard your mind...
Cricket_92_7.cn: 冢周火灵焦乱，剑主必已癫狂，你欲直面此人，务必守住心神……

Cricket_92_8.en: The Sword Master's inner demon persists; it is because he cannot obtain what he desires and cannot let go, willingly letting this love fire burn him to wither...
Cricket_92_8.cn: 冢中剑主心魔不消，乃是求不得，放不下，自甘受这情火焚枯……

Cricket_92_9.en: This Mound is protected by Peculiar fire, and Hostility arises all around. If we enter to slay the evil, we will surely restore this place to Pure Brightness...
Cricket_92_9.cn: 此冢有异火相护，戾气四生，你我入内斩邪，定能还此地清明……

Cricket_92_10.en: Around the Mound, Demonic Qi fills the sky, evil flames hide underground. Just standing here, I feel the heart flame surging from the Mound, billowing unceasingly...
Cricket_92_10.cn: 冢周魔气横空，邪焰藏地，仅立于此，便觉那心焰从冢中涌出，滔滔不息……

Cricket_92_11.en: Love-thoughts within the Mound are like fire, scorching my spiritual intentions into disarray. I might as well break into the Mound today and end the Sword Master's tragic feelings...
Cricket_92_11.cn: 冢中情念如火，燎得我灵意散乱，不若今日便破冢而入，了却剑主悲情……

Cricket_92_12.en: The Sword Master's spiritual intentions are obsessively entangled, hard to abandon and sever. I suppose he is merely a mediocre person, not worth fearing...
Cricket_92_12.cn: 冢中剑主灵意痴缠，难舍难断，想来不过是一庸人，不足为惧……

Cricket_92_13.en: Heart flame burns the Mound, longing turns to ashes. To extinguish this evil blazing fire, one must guard the spiritual platform; when the heart is calm, it naturally cools...
Cricket_92_13.cn: 心焰焚冢，相思成烬，欲熄此邪炽之火，还需守住灵台，心静自凉……

Cricket_92_14.en: Demon fire in the Mound burns Divine and refines souls, but how can the affections in the heart be burned away? This fire is entangled without end, truly detestable...
Cricket_92_14.cn: 冢中魔火焚神炼魄，可心中情意怎烧得尽，此火纠缠不休，着实可厌……

Cricket_92_15.en: This Mound is like a fire prison; the Sword Master is tormented within. This is precisely the chance to seek his Openings and slay him...
Cricket_92_15.cn: 此冢如同火狱，剑主于其中煎熬，正可寻其破绽以杀之……

Cricket_92_16.en: Within this Ignideus Blaze, Peach Blossoms bloom in profusion—an illusion of the Sword Master's heart scene. In the end, it is nothing more than a Mirror Mirage...
Cricket_92_16.cn: 这焚神炼桃花缤纷，乃剑主心景所幻，终不过镜花水月……

Cricket_92_17.en: Around the Mound, spiritual intentions pervade; obsession turns them into fire. The Sword Master is burned by it, thus falling into heterodox paths...
Cricket_92_17.cn: 冢周灵意氤氲，执念将其化火，剑主遭其焚烧，才堕入旁门左道……

Cricket_92_18.en: Within this Ignideus Blaze, spiritual thoughts do not disperse; they linger and turn in the raging flames. The intensity of love truly touches one's heart deeply...
Cricket_92_18.cn: 这焚神炼中灵念不散，于烈火中萦回翻转，情之炽烈，真是感人肺腑……

Cricket_92_19.en: The Sword Master in the Mound is trapped in karmic fire, suffering unspeakably; why not let me add a true fire, burning all these Obsession - Thought...
Cricket_92_19.cn: 冢中剑主困于业火，苦不堪言，不如让我添一把真火，焚尽这些痴念……

Cricket_92_20.en: This Mound has been invaded by Demonic Qi, turning into a fire Mound; if it is allowed to refine the Sword Master day and night, a great disaster will surely brew...
Cricket_92_20.cn: 此冢为魔气所侵，化为火冢，若任其日夜熬炼剑主，久必酿出大祸……

Cricket_92_21.en: {All vegetation around the Sword Mound is reduced to ashes, resentment burning like fire; how sorrowful the Sword Master must be...,The Sword Master in the Mound has a stubborn and foolish Mind, to the point that Obsession - Thought turns into fire; do not approach this place, lest you be contaminated by ill fortune...,Around the Mound, the fire of love burns the Divine; I cannot stand these entanglements of love, truly troublesome...,This Mound's spiritual intentions are accumulated, like unspoken deep feelings; love and hate are buried deep within, almost making me want to compose a melody for it...,This Mound's spiritual Qi flows like living fire, ever-changing and varied; the Sword Master must be extremely adept at the art of maneuvering—I truly wish to compete with him...,Within this Ignideus Blaze, thoughts of love turn into fire, burning the Divine and destroying the soul; my sword cannot cut the threads of love, yet I do not fear this evil...,The burning thoughts in the Mound are all the intention to die for love; the Sword Master must be a reckless one who does not fear death...,This Sword Master's love is passionate and sincere, actually fighting against the Demonic Qi in the Mound; if not for his excessive obsession, he would suit my temperament...,Around the Mound, fire spirits are scorched and chaotic; the Sword Master must have gone insane. Cricket_93_0.en: This Mound's treasure light is flashy; inside, only casual remnant thoughts remain, not any rare treasure. Do not rush forward rashly...
Cricket_93_0.cn: 此冢宝光浮艳，内里也只剩随性遗念，并非什么奇珍，你莫要莽撞上前……

Cricket_93_1.en: This Mound is paved with red gold, truly extremely luxurious and grand; it is not like an Ordinary mausoleum, but rather a place of suppression...
Cricket_93_1.cn: 此冢以赤金铺就，真是极尽奢阔，不似寻常陵寝，倒像是镇厌之地……

Cricket_93_2.en: This Mound has red gold as its exterior, its aura deep and powerful; it is not like the lonely sound of a secluded grave, but rather the sound of metal and stone, solemn and rhythmic...
Cricket_93_2.cn: 此冢以赤金为表，气韵沉雄，不似幽坟孤声，倒如金石之音，肃然有节……

Cricket_93_3.en: Within the Fenghuang Cocoon, spiritual Qi is stagnant; standing here, I feel no room to move, truly suffocating...
Cricket_93_3.cn: 凤凰茧中灵气郁滞，我立于此间，只觉回旋无地，憋闷得很……

Cricket_93_4.en: This Mound's golden radiance is restrained; the Sword Master has unwavering devotion. If not secretly tainted by Demonic Qi, he could have upheld himself with the Tao and walked in the world...
Cricket_93_4.cn: 此冢金芒内敛，剑主矢志不渝，若非魔气暗染，本可以道自持，行于世间……

Cricket_93_5.en: In this Fenghuang Cocoon, the golden bindings are like a prison; the Sword Master is trapped within, yet his will does not waver, which is admirable...
Cricket_93_5.cn: 这凤凰茧中金缚如狱，剑主困于其中，却心志不移，令人叹服……

Cricket_93_6.en: The Sword Master is bound in the Mound, his spiritual intentions still overflowing; why don't we join hands to eliminate him? Beware, delay may lead to changes...
Cricket_93_6.cn: 剑主受缚冢中，灵意犹自四溢，我等何不联手除之，当心迟则有变……

Cricket_93_7.en: Around the Mound, red gold patterns are spread everywhere, serving as a suppressive lock; if you enter to eliminate the demon, do not engage in prolonged battle, lest you be trapped within...
Cricket_93_7.cn: 冢周遍布赤金图纹，乃镇锁之用，你若入内除魔，万不可久战，以免受困其中……

Cricket_93_8.en: The Sword Master's Ambition is unfulfilled; he built this cage for himself with persistent thoughts. It is lamentable that he is obsessed within and ultimately cannot achieve Transcendence...
Cricket_93_8.cn: 剑主壮志未酬，以执念自筑此樊笼，可叹执迷其中，终难超脱……

Cricket_93_9.en: This place has many layers of locks and strict prohibitions; if you wish to enter, break the prohibitions, and slay evil, please let me act as the Vanguard...
Cricket_93_9.cn: 此地困锁重重，禁制森然，若要入内破禁斩邪，请让我为先锋……

Cricket_93_10.en: Around the Mound, the red gold itself becomes a suppressive tool, causing spiritual intentions to become sluggish; if you wish to defeat the Sword Master within, you must not have the slightest hesitation...
Cricket_93_10.cn: 冢周赤金自成镇器，以致灵意沉滞，若欲击败其中剑主，便不可有半分迟疑……

Cricket_93_11.en: Within the Mound, thoughts are chaotic, resentful bonds are heavy; it is better to cut the Gordian knot and eliminate these bonds and locks together with the inner demon...
Cricket_93_11.cn: 冢中心念纷乱，怨缚重重，不如快刀斩乱麻，将这困锁与心魔一同除去……

Cricket_93_12.en: This Mound is covered with red gold, seeming magnificent, but actually it is a fetter; the Sword Master is trapped inside, merely a prisoner...
Cricket_93_12.cn: 此冢外覆赤金看似堂皇，实为桎梏，剑主困陷其中，不过是一囚徒尔……

Cricket_93_13.en: This Fenghuang Cocoon has gold as its walls; its grand form and structure can be described as extremely luxurious and noble, and its origin must not be Ordinary...
Cricket_93_13.cn: 这凤凰茧以金为墙，形制之恢宏，可谓极尽奢贵，来历定非寻常……

Cricket_93_14.en: This Mound is built with red gold, and it is quite sturdy; if we can take away a few pieces of gold material, it will be a worthwhile trip...
Cricket_93_14.cn: 此冢以赤金堆砌，偏又坚固得很，若能取走几块金料，也算不虚此行……

Cricket_93_15.en: Within the Mound, spiritual thoughts accumulate and stagnate, making movement inconvenient; if you wish to eliminate the Sword Master inside, it may require much effort...
Cricket_93_15.cn: 冢内灵念积滞，不便活动，若欲除去其中剑主，恐多费力……

Cricket_93_16.en: This Fenghuang Cocoon's treasure light radiates outward, quite impressive; but I wonder which noble person is trapped within...
Cricket_93_16.cn: 这凤凰茧宝光外放，倒也气派，只不知谁家贵人受困其中……

Cricket_93_17.en: Outside the Mound, red gold flows in myriad transformations, using vitality to suppress the death intention within; I should imitate this method to increase my Cultivation...
Cricket_93_17.cn: 冢外赤金流动万化，以生机镇压其中死意，我当效仿此法，增长修行……

Cricket_93_18.en: This Mound seems silent, yet it contains vitality; whether the Sword Master can break out of the cocoon remains unknown, so we must not underestimate him...
Cricket_93_18.cn: 此冢看似沉寂，实蕴生机，剑主能否破茧而出，尚属未知，自不可小觑……

Cricket_93_19.en: This Mound is meant to suppress calamity; this technique seems familiar. If you wish to go forward and eliminate the demon, I have my own art to counteract it...
Cricket_93_19.cn: 此冢意在镇厄，这手法似曾相识，若欲前去除魔，我自有克制之术……

Cricket_93_20.en: The Sword Master in the Mound harbors an unyielding spirit, lurking here; this demeanor is somewhat similar to my own in the past...
Cricket_93_20.cn: 冢中剑主心含不屈，蛰伏此间，这般意气，倒与我当年有些相似……

If we want to eliminate the Sword Master within, it may take much effort..., This Fenghuang Cocoon emits treasure light, quite impressive, but I wonder which noble is trapped inside..., Outside the Mound, red gold flows in myriad transformations, using vitality to suppress the death intention within; I should imitate this method to increase my Cultivation..., This Mound seems silent, yet it contains vitality; whether the Sword Master can break out of the cocoon remains unknown, so we must not underestimate him..., This Mound is meant to suppress calamity; this technique seems familiar. If you wish to go forward and eliminate the demon, I have my own art to counteract it..., The Sword Master in the Mound harbors an unyielding spirit, lurking here; this demeanor is somewhat similar to my own in the past...}
Cricket_93_21.cn: {冢外宝光闪闪，冢中灵意敛聚，莫不是藏了什么宝贝在里头……,此冢宝光浮艳，内里也只剩随性遗念，并非什么奇珍，你莫要莽撞上前……,此冢以赤金铺就，真是极尽奢阔，不似寻常陵寝，倒像是镇厌之地……,此冢以赤金为表，气韵沉雄，不似幽坟孤声，倒如金石之音，肃然有节……,凤凰茧中灵气郁滞，我立于此间，只觉回旋无地，憋闷得很……,此冢金芒内敛，剑主矢志不渝，若非魔气暗染，本可以道自持，行于世间……,这凤凰茧中金缚如狱，剑主困于其中，却心志不移，令人叹服……,剑主受缚冢中，灵意犹自四溢，我等何不联手除之，当心迟则有变……,冢周遍布赤金图纹，乃镇锁之用，你若入内除魔，万不可久战，以免受困其中……,剑主壮志未酬，以执念自筑此樊笼，可叹执迷其中，终难超脱……,此地困锁重重，禁制森然，若要入内破禁斩邪，请让我为先锋……,冢周赤金自成镇器，以致灵意沉滞，若欲击败其中剑主，便不可有半分迟疑……,冢中心念纷乱，怨缚重重，不如快刀斩乱麻，将这困锁与心魔一同除去……,此冢外覆赤金看似堂皇，实为桎梏，剑主困陷其中，不过是一囚徒尔……,这凤凰茧以金为墙，形制之恢宏，可谓极尽奢贵，来历定非寻常……,此冢以赤金堆砌，偏又坚固得很，若能取走几块金料，也算不虚此行……,冢内灵念积滞，不便活动，若欲除去其中剑主，恐多费力……,这凤凰茧宝光外放，倒也气派，只不知谁家贵人受困其中……,冢外赤金流动万化，以生机镇压其中死意，我当效仿此法，增长修行……,此冢看似沉寂，实蕴生机，剑主能否破茧而出，尚属未知，自不可小觑……,此冢意在镇厄，这手法似曾相识，若欲前去除魔，我自有克制之术……,冢中剑主心含不屈，蛰伏此间，这般意气，倒与我当年有些相似……}

Cricket_94_0.en: The baleful aura outside this Spiritsealer is like a tide; judging by this, the Sword Master must be a reckless brute fond of fighting...
Cricket_94_0.cn: 这伏邪铁外煞气如潮，依此来看，那剑主定是个好勇斗狠的莽夫……

Cricket_94_1.en: Within the Mound, Slaughter intent churns; all around is Yang without Yin. The Sword Master must have endured many battles; facing him head-on may not be easy...
Cricket_94_1.cn: 冢中杀意翻滚，四周阳极无阴，剑主定是久经战阵，与其正面交锋恐非易事……

Cricket_94_2.en: Around the Mound, the baleful aura is like a tide, like a piece of wild music, forming a tune of slaughter, stirring restlessness in the heart...
Cricket_94_2.cn: 冢周煞气如潮，宛如一曲狂乐，自成杀伐之调，令人心生躁烈……

Cricket_94_3.en: That Sword Master is trapped here, causing deathly aura to fill the sky around the Mound, insects and birds all gone—truly unpleasant...
Cricket_94_3.cn: 那剑主困于此地，致使冢周死气弥空，虫鸟俱绝，着实令人不快……

Cricket_94_4.en: Within the Mound, the baleful aura is dense like swords; the Sword Master must be ceaseless in slaughter, always going astray—not the righteous path...
Cricket_94_4.cn: 冢中煞气森然如剑，剑主定是杀伐不休，一味剑走偏锋，非为正道……

Cricket_94_5.en: The Sword Master in the Mound has baleful aura filling the sky, like a one-person army; I can't wait to enter the Mound and fight him...
Cricket_94_5.cn: 冢中剑主煞气弥天，宛如一人成军，我恨不得即刻入冢，与之一战……

Cricket_94_6.en: The Sword Master in the Mound has restless thoughts; he is perfect to Grab for testing my moves. If he truly has skill, he should know my edge...
Cricket_94_6.cn: 冢中剑主心念躁乱，正好拿来试招，若是真有本事，便该知我锋芒……

Cricket_94_7.en: This Mound's baleful aura is fierce; if you venture lightly within, you may face misfortune. It would be better to stay far away...
Cricket_94_7.cn: 此冢煞气凶烈，若你轻涉其间，恐有不测，不如远避为好……

Cricket_94_8.en: The Sword Master is brave indeed, but it's a pity his obsession is not broken; in the end, he is bound by thoughts of Slaughter, unable to attain liberation...
Cricket_94_8.cn: 剑主勇则勇矣，只惜执迷未破，终为杀念所缚，不得解脱……

Cricket_94_9.en: The Sword Master in the Mound has a mind of Toughness, with the Ambition of Hundred Battles. Why is such a hero trapped in this desolate Mound?
Cricket_94_9.cn: 冢中剑主心念坚韧，一身百战之志，如此英雄，为何陷此荒冢？

Cricket_94_10.en: Around the Mound, pure aura is all lost, thoughts withered and decayed; the Sword Master is trapped in filth and does not cleanse himself—pitiful and lamentable...
Cricket_94_10.cn: 冢周清气尽失，心念凋朽，剑主陷浊困而不自洁，可悲可叹……

Cricket_94_11.en: The Sword Master in the Mound is full of baleful aura; he must have experienced many battles. To defeat this enemy, perhaps we can overcome him with technique...
Cricket_94_11.cn: 冢中剑主煞气十足，必是久历战阵，欲破此敌，或可以技制之……

Cricket_94_12.en: All around this Mound, baleful aura brims, grass and trees are withered; the Sword Master's power is at its peak, worthy of a battle with me...
Cricket_94_12.cn: 此冢周遭煞气满盈，草木尽枯，剑主威势正盛，堪配与我一战……

Cricket_94_13.en: The baleful aura crisscrosses within this Spiritsealer, instead causing blood and Qi to surge in my internal organs, my fighting spirit grows stronger, and the Divine becomes clearer...
Cricket_94_13.cn: 这伏邪铁中煞气纵横，反令我内腑血气翻涌，战意愈盛，神愈清明……

Cricket_94_14.en: Around the Mound, baleful glares spread in all directions; the Sword Master must be a cold and arrogant person. If we can find a way to deflate his arrogance, wouldn't that be interesting...
Cricket_94_14.cn: 冢周凶芒四漫，剑主必是冷傲之辈，若能设法挫他锐气，岂不有趣……

Cricket_94_15.en: This Spiritsealer is overflowing with baleful qi inside, conflicting with the Sword Master's righteous thoughts. Outwardly Flourishing, inwardly empty, breaking it is not difficult...
Cricket_94_15.cn: 这伏邪铁内煞气盈溢，与剑主正念相冲，外盛内虚，破之不难……

Cricket_94_16.en: This Mound exudes a sinister aura; though not a blessed site, it far surpasses the mundane scenery. Why not go in and take a look?
Cricket_94_16.cn: 此冢凶气毕露，虽非善地，却也远胜尘俗庸景，何不入内一探？

Cricket_94_17.en: This Spiritsealer has been tainted by Demonic Qi, defying the harmony of Heaven. Should the Sword Master remain lost and fail to return, disaster is inevitable...
Cricket_94_17.cn: 这伏邪铁为魔气所侵，违逆天和，剑主迷而不返，其祸必至……

Cricket_94_18.en: Within the Mound, the Sword Master's thoughts are fierce and resolute; he should be an upright man, yet he is deceived by demons, destroying his own righteous path—truly a pity.
Cricket_94_18.cn: 冢中剑主念头刚烈，应是磊落之士，却为魔所惑，自毁正道，殊为可惜……

Cricket_94_19.en: This Spiritsealer Iron Sword's intent is fearsome, its edge fully bared; the Mound Master must be a peerless hero—I truly wish to cross swords with him!
Cricket_94_19.cn: 这伏邪铁剑意森然，锋芒毕现，冢主必是盖世英豪，真想与其一较高下……

Cricket_94_20.en: This mound's baleful Qi is so intense that not a single insect or ant can survive; even if the Sword Master's heart were as unyielding as iron and stone, he could hardly withstand this daily waning and monthly corrosion...
Cricket_94_20.cn: 此冢煞气太烈，以至虫蚁不生，剑主纵是心如铁石，亦难禁这日销月铄……

Cricket_94_21.en: {Around the Mound, baleful qi is too strong; even the vegetation withers. Even the dullest Cricket is unwilling to approach this place...,The baleful qi outside this Spiritsealer is like a tide; judging by this, the Sword Master must be a reckless brute fond of fighting...,Within the Mound, Slaughter intent churns; all around is Yang without Yin. The Sword Master must have endured many battles; facing him head-on may not be easy...,Around the Mound, baleful qi is like a tide, like a wild tune, forming a slaughter rhythm of its own, stirring impatience in the heart...,That Sword Master is trapped here, causing death qi to fill the air around the Mound, with insects and birds all gone, truly displeasing...,Within the Mound, baleful qi is chilling like swords; the Sword Master must have been endlessly killing, always taking a deviant path, not the righteous way...,The Sword Master within the Mound has baleful qi filling the sky, like a one-man army. A hero like this, why is he trapped in this desolate Mound?,Around the Mound, pure qi is completely lost; thoughts wither and decay. The Sword Master's power is at its peak, worthy to fight with me...,Within this Spiritsealer, baleful qi crisscrosses, instead causing my internal blood to surge, my battle intent growing stronger, my spirit becoming more Pure Brightness...,Around the Mound, fierce light spreads in all directions; the Sword Master must be a cold and proud one. If we can find a way to dampen his edge, wouldn't that be interesting...,This Spiritsealer is overflowing with baleful qi inside, conflicting with the Sword Master's righteous thoughts. Why not enter and explore?,This Spiritsealer has been tainted by Demonic Qi, defying natural harmony. I truly wish to compete with him...,This Mound's baleful qi is so intense that even insects and ants do not breed. Even if the Sword Master's heart is like iron and stone, he cannot withstand this daily erosion and monthly decay...}
Cricket_94_21.cn: {冢周煞气太旺，草木亦随枯索，便是最呆笨的促织也不愿接近此地……,这伏邪铁外煞气如潮，依此来看，那剑主定是个好勇斗狠的莽夫……,冢中杀意翻滚，四周阳极无阴，剑主定是久经战阵，与其正面交锋恐非易事……,冢周煞气如潮，宛如一曲狂乐，自成杀伐之调，令人心生躁烈……,那剑主困于此地，致使冢周死气弥空，虫鸟俱绝，着实令人不快……,冢中煞气森然如剑，剑主定是杀伐不休，一味剑走偏锋，非为正道……,冢中剑主煞气弥天，宛如一人成军，我恨不得即刻入冢，与之一战……,冢中剑主心念躁乱，正好拿来试招，若是真有本事，便该知我锋芒……,此冢煞气凶烈，若你轻涉其间，恐有不测，不如远避为好……,剑主勇则勇矣，只惜执迷未破，终为杀念所缚，不得解脱……,冢中剑主心念坚韧，一身百战之志，如此英雄，为何陷此荒冢？,冢周清气尽失，心念凋朽，剑主陷浊困而不自洁，可悲可叹……,冢中剑主煞气十足，必是久历战阵，欲破此敌，或可以技制之……,此冢周遭煞气满盈，草木尽枯，剑主威势正盛，堪配与我一战……,这伏邪铁中煞气纵横，反令我内腑血气翻涌，战意愈盛，神愈清明……,冢周凶芒四漫，剑主必是冷傲之辈，若能设法挫他锐气，岂不有趣……,这伏邪铁内煞气盈溢，与剑主正念相冲，外盛内虚，破之不难……,此冢凶气毕露，虽非善地，却也远胜尘俗庸景，何不入内一探？,这伏邪铁为魔气所侵，违逆天和，剑主迷而不返，其祸必至……,冢中剑主念头刚烈，应是磊落之士，却为魔所惑，自毁正道，殊为可惜……,这伏邪铁剑意森然，锋芒毕现，冢主必是盖世英豪，真想与其一较高下……,此冢煞气太烈，以至虫蚁不生，剑主纵是心如铁石，亦难禁这日销月铄……}

Cricket_95_0.en: This mound possesses only ornate beauty, nothing but flowing light and illusory scenery—outwardly adorned with an empty and clear appearance, yet within it is full of clutter...
Cricket_95_0.cn: 此冢徒具华美，不过流光幻景，外饰空明之象，内里满是芜杂……

Cricket_95_1.en: Around the Mound, the spiritual Qi is strong, yet it is outwardly flourishing and inwardly hollow. The Sword Master must have been consumed by obsession, thus losing his original heart...
Cricket_95_1.cn: 冢周灵气强盛，却是外华内空，剑主必是饱受执念煎熬，方才失却本心……

Cricket_95_2.en: Around the Mound, thoughts rise and fall like threads, secretly forming a rhythm. Yet it is a pity the tune does not become a movement, and the unfulfilled meaning lies buried within...
Cricket_95_2.cn: 冢周心念起伏如缕，暗自成韵，只惜曲不成章，未尽之意长埋其中……

Cricket_95_3.en: Within the Mound, spiritual Qi flows endlessly. Originally it had a soaring spirit, but alas, fettered by demonic barriers, it cannot Gallop freely...
Cricket_95_3.cn: 冢中灵气流荡不休，本有飞扬意气，惜遭魔障所缚，不得随心驰骋………

Cricket_95_4.en: Around the Mound, light and mist are bewitching, dazzling the eyes. Fortunately, I have cultivated the sword heart in secret, and there is a way to counter it...
Cricket_95_4.cn: 冢周光雾迷幻，迷人眼目，所幸我潜修剑心，正有应对之法……

Cricket_95_5.en: Around the Mound, spiritual meaning flows like a stream, revealing the Sword Master's character. Yet it is a pity that such a heroic spirit is trapped by the inner demon...
Cricket_95_5.cn: 冢周灵意如流，可显剑主风骨，只惜这般英魂，竟为心魔所困……

Cricket_95_6.en: The scenery around the Mound is all the Sword Master's mind images; a single thought can create Mount Meru. He is indeed worthy to fight me...
Cricket_95_6.cn: 冢周光景皆为剑主心像，一念能造须弥，当可与我一战……

Cricket_95_7.en: This place is filled with bewildering illusory lights; all are but phantoms and shadows deliberately luring you to linger. Why waste your focus on them...
Cricket_95_7.cn: 此地幻光迷乱，本是虚光浮影，刻意引你流连，你又何苦分神予它……

Cricket_95_8.en: The illusory scenes around the Mound, though Flourishing, are but worldly illusions. The Sword Master’s single thought turns him into a demon, ultimately wasting all his Cultivation...
Cricket_95_8.cn: 冢周幻景虽盛，实为尘世幻相，剑主一念成魔，终是枉费修行……

Cricket_95_9.en: This Rainbow Ultima appears magnificent, but in truth hides hidden dangers. Do not advance rashly; let me clear the path for you first...
Cricket_95_9.cn: 这鬼神霞看似恢弘，实则暗藏凶险，你切勿轻进，让我先为你开道……

Cricket_95_10.en: Within the Mound, the Sword Master, with a body nearing immortality, still fell to The Depraved. We should all the more steadfastly uphold the Tao heart and not have the slightest slackness...
Cricket_95_10.cn: 冢中剑主近仙之身，犹自堕魔，我辈更当坚守道心，不应有半分懈怠……

Cricket_95_11.en: Within the Mound, the Sword Master bears immortal bones, yet has been corrupted by Demonic Qi. If there is power to balance inner and outer, perhaps his deviation can be corrected...
Cricket_95_11.cn: 冢中剑主身负仙骨，却遭魔气侵心，若有内外相衡之力，或可纠其偏失……

Cricket_95_12.en: Around the Mound, dazzling lights bewilder the eyes, all but barriers of illusory splendor. If they block the path, I shall destroy them all together...
Cricket_95_12.cn: 冢周浮光惑目，皆为虚华之障，若阻前路，我自一并摧毁……

Cricket_95_13.en: The scene before the Mound is dazzling, yet the spiritual Harness is in disarray; one should be cautious and not approach lightly...
Cricket_95_13.cn: 冢前之景流光溢目，却又灵机失序，理当审慎，不可轻近……

Cricket_95_14.en: Around the Mound, the rainbow glow is illusory, yet silent; though elegant, it is not as lively as the long chirping of a Cricket...
Cricket_95_14.cn: 冢周霞光如幻，但无声息，虽也雅致，却不如促织长鸣，更有活气……

Cricket_95_15.en: The illusionary scene outside the Mound is deceptive, but in truth not to be feared; only the Sword Master within the Mound is a formidable enemy...
Cricket_95_15.cn: 冢外幻景惑人，实则不足为惧，唯有冢中剑主是位劲敌……

Cricket_95_16.en: This Rainbow Ultima scene is both illusory and real, with immortal qi swirling within; could the Sword Master be a banished immortal?
Cricket_95_16.cn: 这鬼神霞之景如幻似真，其间竟有仙气缭绕，莫非剑主是位谪仙不成……

Cricket_95_17.en: Around the Mound, spiritual radiance and extraordinary colors shine, immortal qi overflows; yet though outwardly auspicious qi envelops, within it is invaded by Demonic Qi...
Cricket_95_17.cn: 冢周灵辉异彩，仙气四溢，怎奈外表瑞气笼罩，内里却遭魔气所侵……

Cricket_95_18.en: This Rainbow Ultima is full of immortal splendor, yet it is the manifestation of the Sword Master's mind; now trapped by obsession, it is truly a pity...
Cricket_95_18.cn: 这鬼神霞仙辉满目，竟是剑主心象所化，如今困于执念，委实可惜……

Cricket_95_19.en: Around the Mound, immortal light is like a fairy cave, not occupied by evil spirits; that Sword Master must have a great background!
Cricket_95_19.cn: 冢周仙光如同神仙洞府，非为邪祟侵占，那剑主定然大有来头！

Cricket_95_20.en: Rainbow Ultima has been tainted by Demonic Qi; all the immortal light around is false appearance. If you wish to enter and eliminate the demons, by no means act recklessly...
Cricket_95_20.cn: 鬼神霞已受魔气所污，四周仙光尽是虚相，若要入内除魔，万不可鲁莽行事……

Cricket_95_21.en: {The mound is covered with splendid twilight, a scene of wondrous beauty—how could it harbor one who has fallen to demonic ways?,This mound is but hollow splendor, a fleeting illusion of light, adorned with the semblance of emptiness outside, yet filled with chaos within..,The spiritual energy around the mound is strong, but its exterior is hollow and interior empty; the Sword Master must have been tormented by obsession, thus losing their true heart..,The thoughts around the mound ripple like threads, quietly forming a melody, yet it is a pity the tune is incomplete, its unfinished meaning buried deep within..,The spiritual energy within the mound surges endlessly, once bearing a soaring spirit, but alas, bound by demonic obstacles, it cannot roam freely...,The light and mist around the mound are dazzling and deceptive, but fortunately, I have cultivated the Sword Heart and know how to counter them..,The spiritual intent around the mound flows like a stream, revealing the Sword Master's character, yet it is a pity that such a heroic soul is trapped by inner demons..,The sights around the mound are all reflections of the Sword Master's heart; a single thought can create a universe, so they should be worthy to battle me..,This place's illusory light is chaotic, mere empty gleams and floating shadows, deliberately meant to make you linger—why waste your focus on them..,Though the illusions around the mound are grand, they are but worldly phantoms; the Sword Master's single thought turned them into demons, ultimately rendering their cultivation futile..,This ghostly and divine mist appears magnificent, but in truth, it conceals danger—do not advance rashly; let me clear the path for you first..,The Sword Master within the mound is nearly an immortal being, yet has fallen to demonhood; we must hold fast to our Dao heart and slacken not in the slightest..,The Sword Master within the mound bears immortal bones, yet is corrupted by demonic qi; if there were a force to balance the inner and outer, perhaps their deviation could be corrected..,The floating light around the mound blinds the eyes, all but barriers of vanity; if they block the way, I shall destroy them all at once..,The scene before the mound is dazzling with flowing light, yet its spiritual rhythm is disordered; we must be cautious and not approach lightly..,The twilight around the mound is like an illusion, silent and still—though elegant, it lacks the vitality of a cricket's long chirping..,The illusions outside the mound are deceptive, but in truth, they are nothing to fear; only the Sword Master within the mound is a formidable foe..,This ghostly and divine mist is both illusion and reality, yet it exudes immortal aura—could it be that the Sword Master is a banished immortal..,The spiritual radiance and strange colors around the mound overflow with immortal qi, but alas, while the exterior is shrouded in auspicious aura, the interior is invaded by demonic qi..,This ghostly and divine mist is filled with immortal light, yet it is merely a manifestation of the Sword Master's heart; now trapped by obsession, it is truly a pity..,The immortal light around the mound resembles a celestial cave, not a place corrupted by evil; the Sword Master must have a great origin!,The ghostly and divine mist has been tainted by demonic qi, and the surrounding immortal light is all false—if you wish to enter and eliminate the demon, do not act recklessly..}
Cricket_95_21.cn: {冢周霞光遍地，一片奇丽之景，怎会藏着入魔之人？,此冢徒具华美，不过流光幻景，外饰空明之象，内里满是芜杂……,冢周灵气强盛，却是外华内空，剑主必是饱受执念煎熬，方才失却本心……,冢周心念起伏如缕，暗自成韵，只惜曲不成章，未尽之意长埋其中……,冢中灵气流荡不休，本有飞扬意气，惜遭魔障所缚，不得随心驰骋………,冢周光雾迷幻，迷人眼目，所幸我潜修剑心，正有应对之法……,冢周灵意如流，可显剑主风骨，只惜这般英魂，竟为心魔所困……,冢周光景皆为剑主心像，一念能造须弥，当可与我一战……,此地幻光迷乱，本是虚光浮影，刻意引你流连，你又何苦分神予它……,冢周幻景虽盛，实为尘世幻相，剑主一念成魔，终是枉费修行……,这鬼神霞看似恢弘，实则暗藏凶险，你切勿轻进，让我先为你开道……,冢中剑主近仙之身，犹自堕魔，我辈更当坚守道心，不应有半分懈怠……,冢中剑主身负仙骨，却遭魔气侵心，若有内外相衡之力，或可纠其偏失……,冢周浮光惑目，皆为虚华之障，若阻前路，我自一并摧毁……,冢前之景流光溢目，却又灵机失序，理当审慎，不可轻近……,冢周霞光如幻，但无声息，虽也雅致，却不如促织长鸣，更有活气……,冢外幻景惑人，实则不足为惧，唯有冢中剑主是位劲敌……,这鬼神霞之景如幻似真，其间竟有仙气缭绕，莫非剑主是位谪仙不成……,冢周灵辉异彩，仙气四溢，怎奈外表瑞气笼罩，内里却遭魔气所侵……,这鬼神霞仙辉满目，竟是剑主心象所化，如今困于执念，委实可惜……,冢周仙光如同神仙洞府，非为邪祟侵占，那剑主定然大有来头！,鬼神霞已受魔气所污，四周仙光尽是虚相，若要入内除魔，万不可鲁莽行事……}

Cricket_96_0.en: Outside the Mound, bones are scattered everywhere; that Sword Master must be crude and brutal, kill-happy, with not a shred of pity...
Cricket_96_0.cn: 冢外骸骨四散，那剑主必是行径粗蛮，嗜杀成性，无半分可悯之处……

Cricket_96_1.en: Observing this Mound embracing Yin and Yang, one knows the Sword Master's True Qi is Hunyuan and unified, his defense as steady as a rock; we should not underestimate him...
Cricket_96_1.cn: 观此冢负阴抱阳，便知剑主真气混元如一，守势稳若磐石，你我不可小觑……

Cricket_96_2.en: Observing this Mound's surroundings quiet, evil wind echoes among the loong bones, blowing hollow echoes, distant and terrifying...
Cricket_96_2.cn: 观此冢周遭寂静，邪风回荡于龙骨之间，吹出空荡回音，悠远可怖……

Cricket_96_3.en: This Mound's surroundings are covered with bones, making it difficult for ordinary people to move even a cun; but with my method of maneuvering, one can traverse among them...
Cricket_96_3.cn: 此冢周遭骸骨遍地，常人寸步难行，若有我以腾挪之法相助，却可辗转其间……

Cricket_96_4.en: Around the Mound, loong qi is vast, yet due to the distressed heart, it is tainted with demon miasma; now, only with the sword can we eliminate demons!
Cricket_96_4.cn: 冢周龙气浩然，却因困厄之心，染了魔瘴，事到如今，唯有以剑除魔！

Cricket_96_5.en: The loong soul within the Mound is stubborn and untamable; even trapped here, its majesty remains undiminished; such a majestic posture truly evokes admiration...
Cricket_96_5.cn: 冢中龙魄桀骜难驯，纵被困于此处，威势依旧不减，此等雄姿，着实令人心生赞叹……

Cricket_96_6.en: The trapped loong in the Mound, how dare it show fierceness? Let me test my edge on it...
Cricket_96_6.cn: 冢中困龙，岂敢逞凶，便以它来试我锋芒……
Cricket_96_6.ru: Запертый в Кургане Лун, как он смеет проявлять свирепость? Позволь мне испытать свои силы в этом...

Cricket_96_7.en: Around the Sword Mound, white bones cover the ground, very boring; why should we go forward and unnecessarily invite trouble?
Cricket_96_7.cn: 剑冢四周白骨遍地，无趣得很，你我何苦上前，平白惹上一身麻烦……

Cricket_96_8.en: That Sword Master has the ambition to soar to the sky, but is trapped in this desolate Mound, Strayed into Evil; truly makes one sigh in regret...
Cricket_96_8.cn: 那剑主心有凌霄之志，奈何困于荒冢，堕入邪道，当真令人扼腕叹息……

Cricket_96_9.en: Loong bones are scattered all over this place; that Sword Master must be a heinous fiend; I truly wish to compete with him...
Cricket_96_9.cn: 遍地龙骨散落于此，那剑主定是个滔天凶煞，真想与他一较高下……

Cricket_96_10.en: Here, spiritual thoughts are blocked, all because the Sword Master's inner demon is hard to dispel; since it is hard to cut off worldly troubles, why not end it here...
Cricket_96_10.cn: 此地灵念闭塞，皆因剑主心魔难消，既难断俗世纷扰，何不就此了断……

Cricket_96_11.en: The Sword Master in the Mound has an unbreakable obsession, his proud spirit hangs in vain; he truly lacks the wisdom for Breaking the Stalemate, merely putting up a front here...
Cricket_96_11.cn: 冢中剑主执念难解，傲骨空悬，实无破局之慧，不过是在此强撑门面……

Cricket_96_12.en: Around this Candelor's Tail, loong bones are piled up; presumably the Sword Master once fed on loongs, leaving these heaps of dry bones...
Cricket_96_12.cn: 这解龙魄周遭龙骸堆积，想来冢中剑主昔年以龙为食，方留此累累枯骨……

Cricket_96_13.en: Here loong bones are everywhere, the longest ones over a zhang; if not for the Sword Master's years of capturing and slaughtering loong kind, how could so many withered bones remain...
Cricket_96_13.cn: 此处龙骸遍地，最长者足有丈余，若非墓中剑主常年擒杀龙种，何以留存许多枯骸……

Cricket_96_14.en: Around this Candelor's Tail, the ground is full of bones, hurting the soles of our feet. Why should we suffer here in vain? Better to plan carefully...
Cricket_96_14.cn: 这解龙魄周遭满地骸骨，硌得人脚掌生疼，你我何苦在此徒受煎熬，不如从长计议……

Cricket_96_15.en: The Sword Master's mind is solid as cold iron; no method can dissolve it easily, we must strategize well...
Cricket_96_15.cn: 冢中剑主心念凝实，犹如寒铁，万般手段皆难消解，需得好生筹谋……

Cricket_96_16.en: The Sword Master within the Mound bears compassion, yet is trapped by obsession; all phenomena become a cage, and his mind is bound by it...
Cricket_96_16.cn: 冢中剑主心怀悲悯，却困于执念，万象皆成囚笼，心绪为之所缚……

Cricket_96_17.en: Around this Mound, the loong bodies have decayed, their bones all withered; though the Sword Master's lingering might remains, his past glory has turned to smoke...
Cricket_96_17.cn: 此冢周遭龙躯朽坏，骸骨尽枯，冢中剑主余威虽在，往世风华却作云烟……

Cricket_96_18.en: The Sword Master within the Mound originally had a heart seeking Tao and goodness, but failed to see through his inner desires; dragged into delusion by obsession, his original mind became tainted...
Cricket_96_18.cn: 冢中剑主本有求道向善之心，却没能看淡心中渴望，被执念拖入迷障，反令本心蒙尘……

Cricket_96_19.en: The decayed scenery around this Mound is but a manifestation of the Sword Master's mind; with his heart in fetters, all phenomena wither...
Cricket_96_19.cn: 此冢周遭衰败之景，不过剑主心像所化，心有桎梏，以至万象皆枯……

Cricket_96_20.en: The Barren appearance around the Mound is forged by the Sword Master's spiritual thought; now the bleak scene reflects the desolation in his heart...
Cricket_96_20.cn: 冢周荒芜之貌，乃是剑主灵念所铸，如今满目萧瑟，是其心中寂凉……

Cricket_96_21.en: {Bones around the Mound are strangely long and narrow, resembling snakes or loongs; could it be that the Sword Master, even if Possessed, still needs to eat meat to fill his stomach?, Bones scattered outside the Mound; the Sword Master must be brutal in conduct, addicted to Slaughter, with not a shred of pity..., Observing this Mound embracing Yin and Yang, one knows the Sword Master's True Qi is one with Hunyuan, his defense as stable as a rock; we should not underestimate him..., Observing the silence around this Mound, evil wind echoes among the loong bones, blowing out hollow reverberations, distant and terrifying..., This Mound is surrounded by bones everywhere, making it difficult for ordinary people to take even a cun step; but with my method of maneuvering, we can move through it..., The loong aura around the Mound is vast, but due to the trapped heart, it has been tainted by demonic miasma; now, the only way is to use the sword to eliminate the demon!, The loong soul within the Mound is stubborn and untamable; even trapped here, its majesty remains undiminished; such a majestic posture truly evokes admiration..., The trapped loong in the Mound, how dare it act fierce?
